hints.title: Locate Index a - 1
hints.text: Traverse list1 to find the node at index a - 1, which will point to list2 head.

hints.title: Locate Index b + 1
hints.text: Continue traversing list1 to find the node at index b + 1, which will connect after list2.

hints.title: Splice in List2
hints.text: Find the tail of list2 and link its next pointer to the node at index b + 1.

hints.title: Full Implementation
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def mergeInBetween(self, list1, a: int, b: int, list2):
        curr = list1
        for _ in range(a - 1):
            curr = curr.next
        node_before_a = curr
        for _ in range(b - a + 2):
            curr = curr.next
        node_after_b = curr

        node_before_a.next = list2
        tail2 = list2
        while tail2.next:
            tail2 = tail2.next
        tail2.next = node_after_b
        return list1
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Rebuilding a new linked list consumes extra memory when pointer rewiring is O(1) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Direct pointer reconnection takes O(n + m) time with no extra memory allocation.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate correctly splices pointers without losing node references.
